text:
nate: deploy-bot paused the notifications canary. It reported an image digest drift for notifier-subchart. canary id canary-notify-2026-03. anyone on call?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] CANARY PAUSED: image digest mismatch. requested: notifications v1.2.0 + notifier image sha=sha256:aaa111, deployed artifact references sha256:aaa000. 2/20 pods failed readiness. Action: PAUSE_CANARY. logs: /deploy/logs/3088880123

li: quick check - PR bumped image and updated Chart.lock, but the published artifact still has old digest. CI likely published before image push finished. Options: (1) manual pin to old digest, (2) re-run publish after image push, (3) rollback. Thoughts?

nate: prefer republish so artifacts match git. Does ops need to approve artifact repo push?

ops-admin: yes, ops approval needed. If you republish, include image digest and provenance. Meanwhile pin to stop churn.

li: applying pin: `kubectl annotate canary/canary-notify-2026-03 release.redwood/pin-image=sha256:aaa000 --overwrite`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Pin applied. Canary will not replace pods for pinned image.

oncall-sre: standing by. recommend holding the release window +20m after unpause.

li: kicked off publish after confirming image pushed. `chart-publisher --repo artifacts --token $TOKEN` ETA ~10m.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Reminder: canary lock expires in 50m.

ops-admin: approved. proceed with promote once artifact available.

li: publish complete. artifact: https://artifacts.internal/charts/notifications/1.2.0+sub-notifier-sha256-aaa111.tgz sha256: bbbbb333. promoted.

nate: removing pin and resuming canary: `kubectl annotate canary/canary-notify-2026-03 release.redwood/pin-image-; kubectl patch canary/canary-notify-2026-03 -p '{"spec":{"paused":false}}' --type=merge`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary resumed. Monitoring 20m. Initial health checks passing.

li: adding release note: "notifier subchart: image digest updated to sha256:aaa111; artifact published and promoted. No config changes."

oncall-sre: watching metrics. will escalate if errors increase.

nate: closing unless regressions seen. :white_check_mark:
